rootCause.selectorReplayRationale: The successful selector run itself validated and replayed the exact owner-pinned ZIP; only finish_capture provenance argument was wrong. Its report sourceRequestSha256 binds the original owner checkpoint, and raw-stage source record hashes are compared with selector source hashes before import.
